SELECT b.id, b.billing_year AS billingYear, b.total_consumption AS totalConsumption, b.bill_amount AS billAmount, b.paid_amount AS paidAmount, b.paid_time AS paidTime, b.payment_method AS paymentMethod, b.arrears_amount AS arrearsAmount, b.payment_status AS paymentStatus, b.reminder_count AS reminderCount, b.payment_deadline AS paymentDeadline, b.meter_id AS meterId, b.customer_id AS customerId, c.customer_name AS customerName, c.contact, c.address FROM electricity_bill b LEFT JOIN electricity_customer c ON b.customer_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0
b.deleted = 0 AND b.payment_status IN ('未缴', '部分缴纳', '逾期')
AND b.billing_year = #{billingYear}
AND c.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%')
ORDER BY b.arrears_amount DESC

SELECT billing_year AS billingYear, COUNT(*) AS totalBills, ROUND(SUM(total_consumption), 2) AS totalConsumption, ROUND(SUM(arrears_amount), 2) AS totalArrears, ROUND(AVG(total_consumption), 2) AS avgConsumption, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status = '已缴' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status = '未缴' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status = '逾期' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue FROM electricity_bill b
deleted = 0
GROUP BY billing_year ORDER BY billing_year ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN arrears_amount = 0 THEN '无欠费' WHEN arrears_amount < 5000 THEN '5000元以下' WHEN arrears_amount < 20000 THEN '5000-20000元' ELSE '20000元以上' END AS arrearsRange, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(SUM(arrears_amount), 2) AS totalAmount FROM electricity_bill b
deleted = 0
GROUP BY arrearsRange ORDER BY MIN(arrears_amount)
